(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀12 H7 bore (D4) carries a tight ISO fit on a part that is zinc plated (I.Z.B.P.), but the drawing does not state whether the H7 tolerance applies before or after plating. Without this, the finished hole may be undersize and reject the mating pin. The designer should add a note specifying that the H7 tolerance applies after surface treatment, or provide an adjusted pre-plate size.","recommended_correction":"Add a note such as 'H7 TOLERANCE APPLIES AFTER PLATING' or specify a pre-plate bore size that accounts for the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness."}]}
